name: straddle pancake pulses
description: In a wide seated straddle you lean forward from the hips in small, controlled pulses. It works the hamstrings and inner thighs toward a deeper pancake fold.
instructions: Sit with your legs spread wide, knees straight and kneecaps pointing up.
Sit tall and tilt your pelvis forward as if pushing your belly toward the floor.
Reach your hands forward and lean in a little further with each pulse.
Keep your back long instead of rounding to reach.
Pulse slowly and breathe, then sit back up to finish.
